results.releaseNotes:
Organ and electric keys, and a Studio you can line things up in.

• ORGAN AND ELECTRIC KEYS
Advanced Split can now pull a Hammond organ, or a Rhodes and other electric pianos, into their own track — alongside synths, which it already did. A song built on an organ no longer has it buried in Other.

• SEE THE BEAT
The Studio draws the song's beats down the timeline, with the first of each bar picked out. It always snapped to them; now you can aim at them, which is what lining up a recording by eye needs.

• SOLO
Every track in the Studio has a solo button beside mute, for hearing one part on its own.

• TRACK NAMES YOU CAN READ
Names sat in a column too narrow for them and came out as single letters. They have their own line now.

• RECORDINGS THAT LAND WHERE YOU PLAYED THEM
A take that couldn't be matched to the music was placed with no correction for the delay between hearing a song and your voice reaching the microphone. It now uses what the device reports instead, and a weak match no longer places a take on a guess. Most noticeable on headphones.

• FIXED
Exporting could crash the app, and every exported MP3 was missing about a second from the end. Newly separated parts could appear muted with a flat waveform when they were playing perfectly well.

Split any song into 6 isolated stems on your iPhone — vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other. Nothing uploads. Nothing waits in a cloud queue. No subscription required.

StemLab runs the AI separation entirely on your device, then opens a full multi-track mixer with studio FX, A/B looping, recording, and stem export. Built for musicians, producers, and singers who want clean, isolated stems without monthly fees.

SEPARATE
Imports MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, even MP4 and MOV video — up to 500 MB per file. Pick a 4-stem or 6-stem AI model to extract vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and more in a single pass. Works as a vocal remover, instrumental maker, acapella extractor, and backing track creator. Everything happens on your iPhone — your music never leaves the device.

MIX
A real multi-track mixer, not just a separator. Per-stem volume, solo, mute. Set A/B loop points to slow down a solo, transcribe a phrase, or rehearse the chorus on repeat. Scrub the timeline with centisecond precision and watch live waveforms render in real time.

MAKE IT YOURS
Record your own vocal over the instrumental, lay down a guitar take on top of the AI bass, or import any audio file as a custom layer. Build mashups, track covers, write demos, replace a stem entirely — all inside one session, on your phone.

ADD EFFECTS
Shape each stem with a 6-effect chain: Pitch Shift, Reverb, Delay, Compressor, 4-band EQ, and Saturation. Run Bus FX on the master mix. Bypass any effect without removing it. Save your settings as a reusable preset and load them on the next song with one tap.

EXPORT
Send out individual stems or a new stereo mixdown in WAV, FLAC, or M4A — now baked with your FX chain, so your Pitch Shift, Reverb, Delay, Compressor, EQ, and Saturation settings carry straight into the export. Pick your sample rate (44.1 / 48 / 96 kHz) and bit depth (16 / 24 / 32-bit). Drop the result straight into your DAW, sampler, looper, or any other app.

Built for guitarists isolating solos, bassists transcribing lines, beatmakers pulling clean acapellas, DJs making edits, music teachers building practice tracks, worship leaders covering for missing players, and singers laying covers over original songs.
